name: hdd_automount
description: Mount an internal/USB HDD, make it persistent (fstab), link it to MPD and refresh the library.
author: karkolom223

volumio_info.details: Select disk from list, mount, automount via fstab, symlink to MPD library, permissions and mpc update.
volumio_info.changelog: 1.2.0 - direct commands, no helper; install.sh adds mkdir+sed to sudoers
